include.title: Imperial College London — President's PhD Scholarships
include.benefits: Full tuition (home and overseas rate), annual stipend ~£22,000, and £1,000 annual research budget.
include.eligibility: Open to applicants of any nationality. No nationality restrictions.
include.summary: The President's PhD Scholarships fund ~25 outstanding doctoral students per year across all Imperial departments. International students are fully eligible.
criteria: Open to applicants of any nationality.
Must hold or expect a first-class undergraduate degree or equivalent.
Strong research proposal required.
Must be applying to a full-time PhD programme at Imperial.

include.title: UCL Overseas Research Scholarship (ORS)
include.benefits: Overseas tuition fee differential waiver for full PhD duration; combine with stipend-paying awards (EPSRC/Wellcome/ESRC DTPs) for a fully funded package.
include.eligibility: Open to international (overseas-fee-paying) doctoral applicants at UCL with an outstanding academic record.
include.summary: UCL Overseas Research Scholarships reduce the fee burden for international PhD students by covering the overseas fee premium. Combined with research council studentships, the package is fully funded.
criteria: Must be an international (overseas-fee-paying) applicant.
Outstanding undergraduate and postgraduate academic record required.
Must apply to a full-time PhD programme at UCL.

include.title: President's Doctoral Scholar Award — University of Manchester
include.benefits: Stipend above the UKRI standard rate, full home/international tuition fee waiver, £1,000 annual research fund, bespoke leadership development programme.
include.eligibility: Open to outstanding domestic and international applicants applying for a full-time PhD at the University of Manchester.
include.summary: The President's Doctoral Scholar Award is a prestigious fully funded PhD award combining a competitive stipend with a leadership development programme.
criteria: Open to international applicants.
Exceptional academic record (first-class degree or equivalent).
Strong research proposal and supervisor agreement required.

include.title: Edinburgh Global Research Scholarships
include.benefits: Full overseas tuition fee waiver for the PhD duration. Combine with EPSRC/ESRC DTP studentship for a full stipend.
include.eligibility: Open to applicants from outside the UK applying for full-time PhD study at the University of Edinburgh.
include.summary: Edinburgh Global Research Scholarships remove the overseas fee barrier for international PhD candidates, making fully funded study at Edinburgh accessible when combined with a stipend award.
criteria: Open to international applicants (outside the UK).
Strong academic record and research potential required.
Must apply for a full-time PhD at Edinburgh.

include.title: Warwick Chancellor's International Scholarships
include.benefits: Full overseas tuition fee waiver and annual stipend at UKRI rate (~£19,000) for 3–3.5 years of full-time PhD study at Warwick.
include.eligibility: Open to international applicants from all countries admitted to a full-time PhD programme at the University of Warwick.
include.summary: Warwick Chancellor's International Scholarships provide fully funded PhD opportunities to outstanding international candidates across all departments.
criteria: Open to international applicants of any nationality.
First-class degree or equivalent required.
Must be applying for a full-time PhD at Warwick.

include.title: MIT Graduate Research Fellowships
include.benefits: Full tuition waiver, annual stipend ~USD 44,000, and student health insurance. Funding is provided through research assistantships, teaching assistantships, or named fellowships.
include.eligibility: Open to applicants of any nationality. MIT doctoral students in STEM programs are typically fully funded from day one. International students are fully eligible.
include.summary: MIT PhD students in science and engineering programs receive full financial support — no tuition charge and a competitive living stipend — as part of their admission. International applicants are welcome.
criteria: Open to applicants from any country.
Funding is embedded in the admissions offer — no separate application required.
Outstanding academic and research record essential.

include.title: Yale Doctoral Fellowship
include.institution: Yale Graduate School of Arts & Sciences
include.benefits: Five-year fully funded package: full tuition waiver, annual stipend ~USD 40,000, and student health insurance for the full PhD duration.
include.eligibility: Open to all doctoral applicants regardless of nationality. Funding is included as part of admission to a Yale GSAS doctoral programme.
include.summary: All students admitted to doctoral programmes at Yale's Graduate School receive a multi-year fully funded fellowship covering tuition and a living stipend. International students are fully eligible.
criteria: Funding is automatically part of every doctoral admissions offer.
Open to international applicants from all countries.
Highly competitive — strong research focus required.

include.title: Princeton University Graduate Fellowship
include.benefits: Full tuition waiver, annual stipend ~USD 40,000, health insurance, and subsidised housing for up to five years.
include.eligibility: Open to applicants of any nationality. Every admitted doctoral student receives full funding as part of their admissions offer.
include.summary: Princeton guarantees full funding to all admitted PhD students covering tuition, fees, and a generous living stipend for the expected duration of the program.
criteria: Funding is embedded in the PhD admission offer.
Open to international applicants from all countries.
Highly competitive — Princeton accepts very few students per year.

include.title: UBC Four Year Doctoral Fellowship (4YF)
include.benefits: Four years of guaranteed funding: annual stipend of at least CAD 22,000 plus full tuition coverage throughout the doctoral program.
include.eligibility: Open to applicants of any nationality admitted to a doctoral programme at UBC. International applicants are fully eligible.
include.summary: The UBC Four Year Doctoral Fellowship guarantees four years of tuition and stipend support to all admitted PhD students with no restrictions on nationality.
criteria: Open to international applicants from all countries.
Funding is embedded in the PhD admissions offer.
Strong academic record and research potential required.

include.title: University of Toronto School of Graduate Studies Fellowships
include.benefits: Guaranteed minimum funding package for all PhD students: typically CAD 15,000–20,000/year in fellowship support plus TA/RA income, covering full living costs in Toronto.
include.eligibility: Open to all full-time doctoral students at the University of Toronto. International applicants are eligible and receive the same funding guarantee.
include.summary: The University of Toronto guarantees a minimum funding package to all PhD students through fellowships, teaching assistantships, and research assistantships. International students are included.
criteria: Open to international applicants.
Funding is guaranteed as part of the PhD admissions offer.
Merit-based scholarships (SSHRC, NSERC, OGS) available on top of the base package.

include.title: Leiden University PhD Positions (Employed)
include.benefits: Salaried employment: PhD candidates earn EUR 2,770–3,530/month gross, with full Dutch social benefits including health insurance and pension contributions.
include.eligibility: Open to applicants of any nationality. Individual positions are advertised by research groups across all Leiden faculties.
include.summary: Leiden University PhD candidates are employed on standard Dutch academic employment contracts. Positions are advertised continuously and are open to international applicants worldwide.
criteria: Open to applicants from any country.
Excellent MSc or equivalent degree required.
Applications are assessed per individual vacancy by the hosting research group.

include.title: KU Leuven Doctoral Fellowships
include.deadline: Rolling — check individual research group calls
include.benefits: Monthly fellowship or employment contract typically EUR 2,300–2,600 net covering full living costs in Belgium. No tuition fees for enrolled PhD candidates.
include.eligibility: Open to applicants of any nationality. Individual positions are advertised by research groups across KU Leuven's 14 faculties throughout the year.
include.summary: KU Leuven doctoral fellowships and junior researcher positions provide full financial support for PhD candidates from around the world across science, engineering, humanities, and social sciences.
criteria: Open to international applicants of any nationality.
Excellent Master's degree in a relevant discipline required.
Applications are submitted per individual position to the hosting supervisor.

include.title: TU Delft PhD Position — Fully Employed
include.benefits: PhD candidates are full employees: gross salary starting ~EUR 2,770/month rising to EUR 3,539 in year 4, plus holiday allowance, pension, and full Dutch social security.
include.eligibility: Open to applicants of any nationality with an excellent MSc in a relevant technical or scientific field. Individual positions are advertised by departments.
include.summary: TU Delft PhD candidates are full employees of the university — not students — receiving a competitive Dutch salary with all benefits. The global research community is very internationally diverse.
criteria: Open to international applicants from any country.
Outstanding MSc degree in an engineering, science, or design discipline.
Applications are made per individual vacancy posted by departments.

include.title: NUS Research Scholarship
include.benefits: Full tuition fee subsidy and monthly stipend of SGD 2,500 (PhD) or SGD 2,000 (Research Master's), plus a settling-in allowance for new students.
include.eligibility: Open to applicants of any nationality. Awarded competitively based on academic merit and research potential during the NUS admissions process.
include.summary: The NUS Research Scholarship supports outstanding international graduate students at one of Asia's top research universities in Singapore, covering full tuition and a living stipend.
criteria: Open to applicants from any country.
Strong academic record (First or Upper Second class degree) required.
Scholarship is assessed as part of the graduate admissions process — no separate application needed.

include.title: NTU Research Scholarship
include.deadline: Check source — January (August intake), June (January intake)
include.benefits: Full tuition fee waiver and monthly stipend of SGD 2,000–2,500 for the full duration of the PhD program.
include.eligibility: Open to applicants from any country. Selection is based on research potential and academic excellence.
include.summary: NTU Research Scholarships fund outstanding PhD candidates from around the world, covering full tuition and a monthly living stipend at one of Asia's top-ranked universities.
criteria: Open to international applicants from any country.
Strong academic record (Honours degree or equivalent) required.
Research potential and fit with supervisor's research agenda assessed.

include.title: Monash Graduate Scholarship + International Tuition Scholarship
include.benefits: Monash Graduate Scholarship (MGS): living stipend ~AUD 32,000/year. Monash International Tuition Scholarship (MITS): full overseas tuition waiver. Combined = fully funded for international PhD students.
include.eligibility: Open to applicants of any nationality applying for a full-time PhD at Monash. Both scholarships are awarded together for international students.
include.summary: The Monash Graduate Scholarship and Monash International Tuition Scholarship together provide a fully funded PhD package for international students in Melbourne — one of the world's most liveable cities.
criteria: Open to international applicants of any nationality.
Honours degree with First Class equivalent or GPA 3.5+/4.0 required.
Must be applying for a full-time PhD at Monash.

include.title: ANU University Research Scholarship (ANURS)
include.benefits: Full tuition fee offset and annual living stipend ~AUD 32,000 for 3.5 years (PhD), plus thesis writing-up allowance and relocation support.
include.eligibility: Open to domestic and international candidates applying for a full-time higher degree by research (HDR) at ANU.
include.summary: ANU University Research Scholarships support international PhD students at Australia's national university in Canberra with full tuition and a generous living stipend.
criteria: Open to international applicants of any nationality.
Honours degree (First Class) or Master's by research required.
Must apply for a full-time PhD or MPhil at ANU.

include.title: Funded PhD Studentships — jobs.ac.uk
include.benefits: Varies by position: typical UK studentships include full tuition (home or international rate) and a living stipend at or above the UKRI rate (~£19,000/year).
include.eligibility: Varies by position. Many studentships specify eligibility for international applicants. Filter for 'international' on the jobs.ac.uk search page.
include.summary: jobs.ac.uk is the largest academic jobs board in the UK and lists hundreds of individual funded PhD studentships from UK and international universities at any given time.
criteria: Eligibility varies by individual vacancy — check each listing.
Many positions are open to international applicants.
A first-class or upper second-class degree is typically required.

include.title: EURAXESS — Funded PhD Positions in Europe
include.benefits: Varies by position: MSCA doctoral positions pay EUR 3,400–4,000/month gross; university positions are salaried at national academic rates.
include.eligibility: Open to researchers of any nationality. MSCA mobility rule applies (must not have lived in the host country for more than 12 months in the past 3 years).
include.summary: EURAXESS is the official European Commission jobs portal for academic and research vacancies, listing thousands of funded PhD positions across Europe open to international applicants.
criteria: Open to researchers of any nationality.
MSCA positions require the mobility rule to be met.
A Master's or equivalent degree is typically required.

include.title: FindAPhD — Fully Funded International PhD Opportunities
include.benefits: Varies by position: most listed positions include full tuition waiver and a living stipend at or above the UKRI rate.
include.eligibility: Filtered for non-European / international applicants. Each listing specifies its own eligibility requirements.
include.summary: FindAPhD is the world's largest database of PhD opportunities. This pre-filtered link shows fully funded positions explicitly open to non-European/international applicants.
criteria: Each listing specifies its own eligibility — check individual entries.
Filter is set to 'fully funded' and 'international applicants'.
Strong academic record and research interest required.

include.title: Oxford Clarendon Scholarship
include.benefits: Full fees (home and overseas rate) and full living costs grant (approx. £18,622/year) for up to 3–4 years.
include.eligibility: Open to graduate applicants of any nationality to any Oxford graduate programme. Awarded to the highest-achieving applicants automatically.
include.summary: The Clarendon Scholarship is one of Oxford's most prestigious awards, covering full fees and living expenses. There is no separate application — all graduate applicants are automatically considered.
criteria: Open to all nationalities.
Automatic consideration — no separate application.
Must apply for graduate admission at Oxford.
Awards are merit-based, given to outstanding applicants.

include.title: Cambridge Trust International Scholarship
include.benefits: Full fees (home and overseas rate) and maintenance allowance covering living costs for duration of course.
include.eligibility: Open to international students of any nationality accepted to a full-time postgraduate programme at Cambridge.
include.summary: Cambridge Trust funds over 300 international scholars annually across all disciplines. Applicants are considered automatically when they apply for Cambridge postgraduate admission.
criteria: Open to all nationalities.
Must be accepted to a full-time Cambridge postgraduate programme.
Automatic consideration at application — no separate form.
Merit-based selection.

include.title: Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme (HKPFS)
include.benefits: HKD 27,600/month stipend, annual conference travel allowance of HKD 13,800. Tuition is covered by host university.
include.eligibility: Open to students of any nationality worldwide. Must not have previously studied at a Hong Kong institution at postgraduate level.
include.summary: HKPFS awards 300 fellowships annually to outstanding PhD applicants at Hong Kong's top 8 universities (HKU, HKUST, CUHK, PolyU, CityU, HKBU, LingU, EdUHK). One of Asia's most competitive scholarships.
criteria: Open to all nationalities.
Must not have previously enrolled at a Hong Kong institution at postgraduate level.
Apply through RGC portal AND through the host university.
Typical deadline: 1 December each year.

include.title: Japanese Government (MEXT) Research Student Scholarship
include.institution: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology, Japan
include.deadline: Check Japanese embassy in your country (typically April–May each year)
include.benefits: Full tuition waiver, monthly living allowance (¥117,000–¥145,000), airfare to and from Japan, and Japanese language training.
include.eligibility: Open to citizens of countries with diplomatic relations with Japan, typically 35 years or younger, applying through Japanese embassies or directly through Japanese universities.
include.summary: The MEXT Scholarship is Japan's flagship international scholarship funding degree-seeking research students at Japanese national universities. Covers all study costs for Master's and PhD.
criteria: Open to citizens of countries with diplomatic ties with Japan.
Age limit typically 35 years.
Two routes: Embassy recommendation or University recommendation.
Strong academic record required.

include.title: Eiffel Excellence Scholarship (France)
include.institution: Campus France / Ministry of Europe and Foreign Affairs
include.deadline: Mid-January each year (institutions apply on behalf of students)
include.benefits: Monthly stipend (~€1,181 for Master's, ~€1,400 for PhD), travel costs, cultural activities, health insurance.
include.eligibility: Open to international students (non-French) enrolled in a French grande école or university. Applications are submitted by the French institution, not directly by students.
include.summary: The Eiffel Excellence Scholarship attracts international talent to France's leading graduate schools and universities for Master's and PhD programmes across all disciplines.
criteria: Must be a non-French national.
Maximum age: 30 for Master's, 35 for PhD.
Application submitted by French institution — contact your target institution.
Priority given to students from target countries listed by Campus France.

include.title: NSF Graduate Research Fellowship Program (GRFP)
include.benefits: $37,000/year stipend for 3 years, $16,000/year institutional allowance to cover tuition and fees.
include.eligibility: US citizens, nationals, or permanent residents who are in the first or second year of a STEM graduate programme (or have not yet started). Not open to international students unless they are US citizens/permanent residents.
include.summary: The NSF GRFP is the oldest and most prestigious US graduate fellowship for STEM research, awarded to about 2,000 students per year.
criteria: Must be a US citizen, national, or permanent resident.
Early-career: apply in 1st or 2nd year of graduate school, or before starting.
STEM fields only.
Strong research statement and two reference letters required.

include.title: Taiwan ICDF International Higher Education Scholarship
include.institution: International Cooperation and Development Fund, Taiwan
include.benefits: Full tuition, round-trip airfare, accommodation, NTD 10,000/month living allowance, health insurance.
include.eligibility: Open to nationals of Taiwan's diplomatic allies and technical cooperation partner countries. PhD and Master's programmes at designated Taiwanese universities.
include.summary: The Taiwan ICDF scholarship funds students from developing-country partners to pursue Master's and PhD degrees at leading Taiwanese universities, fully covering all costs.
criteria: Must be a national of a Taiwan ICDF partner country (list on website).
Under 40 years old (Master's), under 45 (PhD).
Strong academic record required.
Apply through your country's government or Taiwan ICDF directly.

include.title: VLIR-UOS Scholarship (Belgium)
include.benefits: Monthly living allowance (€800–€1,200), tuition waiver, one-off travel grant, health insurance, installation allowance.
include.eligibility: Open to citizens of 31 sub-Saharan African and developing Asian countries listed on the VLIR-UOS website. For Master's programmes at Flemish universities.
include.summary: VLIR-UOS awards around 170 scholarships annually to students from developing countries for fully funded Master's study at Flemish universities in Belgium.
criteria: Citizens of 31 eligible countries in Sub-Saharan Africa and Asia (see VLIR-UOS website).
Must not have permanent residency in Belgium or another developed country.
Apply directly to VLIR-UOS online portal.
Typical deadline: 1 February.
